name: brewdocs
description: Brew your docs, serve them hot. Point it at a GitHub repo or npm package to get a clean, hosted one-page doc site.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/plugin-sdk/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run map:check && npm run gate && npm test
